expectations: the Phase 2 gate run on a real VM
context: area: deploy/vm (host.sh, setup.sh, traefik.nomad.hcl, caravana.service, caravana-policy.hcl)
area: deploy/dev/setup.sh (Docker, CNI, Nomad pinned with checksums)
area: .github/workflows (CI only today, no release workflow)
area: internal/config, internal/ui (public console behind Traefik, trusted proxies)
constraint: constitution I one binary + SQLite, one-command install, 2 GB VM
constraint: constitution VII ACLs from the first install
finding: the console/API are loopback-only today (SSH tunnel); webhook host routes only /v1/webhooks/
intent: One pasted command turns a fresh Ubuntu VM into a working public Caravana host; same command upgrades; uninstall keeps apps

decisions.decision: Bash installer + per-release tarball (binary + host files) + SHA256SUMS; --from for local artifacts
decisions.why: host files stay real, lintable files; one install path for release, rehearsal and lab
decisions.rejected: heredocs in one script; a caravana install Go subcommand

decisions.decision: tools/release.sh + a tag workflow using gh
decisions.why: one builder for every artifact, no new tool

decisions.decision: ldflags version, caravana version, version in /v1/health
decisions.why: upgrade/downgrade decisions and confirming the new process answers
decisions.rejected: reading the version from the tarball name only

decisions.decision: Versioned /opt/caravana dirs + current symlink; data copied before upgrade and restored with the binary on failure
decisions.why: a migrated store is unreadable by the old binary

decisions.decision: One console domain routed by Traefik to :7070, trusted proxies 127.0.0.1,::1, webhook-only listener dropped on hosts
decisions.why: main listener already serves webhooks; trusted proxies give Secure cookies and real client IPs

decisions.decision: Console route goes live only after the admin step
decisions.why: no public console without an admin

decisions.decision: Installer test on a throwaway Lima Ubuntu VM with --acme none
decisions.why: tests install, rerun, upgrade, rollback, refusal and uninstall without a public VM
decisions.rejected: only testing on a paid VM

plan.summary: Bash installer from release tarballs, upgrade with data+binary rollback, public console via Traefik, host.sh wraps it, Lima VM test
plan.key_finding: The repo is private, so the curl-from-releases command works for others only once it is public; the console is loopback-only today and needs trusted proxies to be public

tasks.summary: 15 tasks: foundational version/host files/release.sh, installer (install, upgrade, uninstall) in one owned script, rehearsal + Lima VM test + gate, release workflow, docs, validation

approach: A bash installer, published per release with a checksum-verified tarball of the binary and host files, does preflight, Docker/Nomad/Traefik/Caravana setup, admin creation, then routes the console domain; reruns upgrade with rollback of binary and data; host.sh up runs it with --from; a Lima VM test covers install, rerun, upgrade, rollback and uninstall.
